_about: Final model v4-reference (plan claude/final_model_plan_2026-11-03.md, decisions FM-01 to FM-30). Every openCARP setting is in config/model.par. This file holds (1) 'sweep': the variables the parameter sweeps change, each with its baseline, the Methodology's planned values and what it acts on; (2) 'fixed': settings openCARP cannot read (mesh, bath geometry, electrodes, analysis). Keys starting with '_' are documentation. Units are in key names.

region.actsOn: label exported to Wang's inf0_roof1 column
region._about: Regions are parameter sets (FM-08): the 'roof' variant in config/sweeps sets wallMm 1.6 and uniform fibres.

wallMm._source: FM-48 (Matilda, 12 Nov 2026): mean left atrial wall thickness 1.89 +- 0.48 mm over 12 sites in 60 patients (Beinart et al. 2011, J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol 22:1232-1236, CT; value as given in the Methodology, primary paper not re-read here [VERIFY]), rounded to the 0.1 mm transmural mesh. Replaces the inferior-wall value 1.1 mm of FM-08 (Whitaker et al. 2021 median 1.14 mm), which the planned 1.0 mm variant now brackets. Must be a multiple of fixed.tissue.spacingTransmuralMm.

fibres._source: Pashakhanloo et al. 2016: near-perpendicular layers, abrupt mid-wall transition in the posterior-inferior LA; constant on the roof. Angles are assumptions (none reported numerically). Angle from +x, counter-clockwise seen from the catheter (FM-06).

epicardialMedium._source: none = no-flux epicardium (bath on the catheter side and laterally); blood = 5 mm bath on every side as Leenknegt et al. 2023 (FM-05).

scar._source: FM-07. ablation = healthy extracellular tensor (model.par); ablationPorated = sigma_i + sigma_e of healthy tissue (theoretical upper bound); insulating = earlier reference case. Intracellular lesion conductivity 1e-6 S/m in all three.

waveAngleDeg._source: Angle of the wave direction from +x; 0 = parallel to the lesion boundary, 90 = travelling toward the lesion (FM-17). Wang mapped during distal CS pacing: wavefronts reach the line at varied angles.

gapsMm._source: Electrode surface to tissue distance. Baseline 0.25 and 1 mm = the two contact cases of Rodrigo et al. 2026 (PLoS Comput Biol 22:e1014493; cylindrical electrodes 0.5 mm radius, 1 mm long). 3 mm removed (FM-40): its electrode top would lie 1 mm below the no-flux top of the 5 mm bath.

electrodeRadiusMm._source: HD Grid 1 mm electrodes (Wang supplement); Methodology diameter sweep 0.5-2 mm.

gridSpacingMm._source: HD Grid 4 mm centre-to-centre (Wang supplement). Fixed at the clinical catheter's spacing; not swept (FM-39, Matilda 10 Nov 2026).

bipoleOrientation._source: FM-39. selected = the larger peak-to-peak of the two orthogonal 4 mm pairs of each grid square, as EnSite does with the HD Grid (Siddiqui 2019, EP Lab Digest 19(2)); x = the pair along x (parallel to the lesion boundary and to the baseline wave); y = the pair along y (across the boundary). Orientation changes bipolar amplitude (Hwang et al. 2019, PLoS Comput Biol 15:e1006765).

noiseSdMv._source: Gaussian white noise per electrode at the acquisition rate, in model mV (no calibration, FM-25). Assumption [VERIFY]: no source. The planned values form a doubling series; the pre-registered primary test is the change-point shift per doubling of noise (FM-25). FM-44: 0.04 mV added so the series reaches higher relative noise floors (noise peak-to-peak / healthy bipolar median, measurements/amplitudes.json): the model's amplitudes are not calibrated, so the level that matches a clinical signal-to-noise ratio is not known in advance and may lie above 0.02 mV.

cvTargetMPerS._source: van Schie et al. 2021 LA median 0.90 m/s; 0.70 and 1.25 m/s bracket reported central values (DL-2026-10-28-03).

ionicModel._source: Koivumaki et al. 2011 is the planned sensitivity model; its openCARP name is [VERIFY] before it is listed here.

tissue._about: Slab x in [-Lx/2, Lx/2], y in [-Ly/2, Ly/2], z in [-wall/2, wall/2]; catheter on +z. Lesion condition: transmural ablation strip boundaryYmm - lesionWidthMm <= y < boundaryYmm (tag 5); tissue beyond it is viable but isolated (tag 1, not stimulated), as after single-ring isolation (FM-24). lesionWidthMm 5.6 = mean ablation lesion width in Wang's supplement (5.6 +- 1.2 mm, Friedman et al. 2021 as cited there). Mesh 0.25 mm in-plane, 0.1 mm through the wall (FM-04).

bath._about: Blood 0.74 S/m (model.par). Ground = 1 mm cube at the (max x, max y, max z) bath corner; no-flux outer walls (Leenknegt et al. 2023; DL-2026-11-02-02).

stimulus._about: Transmembrane current on viable-tissue nodes within stripWidth of the trailing edge of the wave direction (FM-17); nodes touching a lesion element, and the isolated tissue beyond the lesion (y < boundary), are excluded.

conditioning._about: Single Courtemanche cell paced with bench at the model.par cycle length (openCARP limit-cycle workflow).

numerics._about: Monodomain throughout (FM-23), so no prepacing restart is needed. boomeramg: DL-2026-11-01-07.

electrodes._about: 4 x 4 grid, rows along y, columns along x; cylinders with axes along x. An electrode is the set of bath mesh nodes inside its cylinder (FM-14); its signal is the mean extracellular potential over that set, computed by reciprocity from its lead field (FM-23).

window._about: FM-28 (rule of DL-2026-10-28-08 applied per placement): from intact last-beat activation of catheter-facing nodes under each placement (|x - centre x| <= 1.5 x grid spacing + electrode length / 2, |y - centre y| <= 1.5 x grid spacing + electrode radius). Every placement gets the same window length.

analysis._filters: FM-09, FM-22: rational resampling of every unipole from the 5 kHz simulation output to the EnSite X acquisition rate (scipy.signal.resample_poly, Kaiser-window FIR anti-alias; Europace 2024;26:euae154), with resampleMarginMs of signal kept beyond the last window (the FIR half-length is 5 ms), then 30-500 Hz causal Butterworth band-pass for bipolar and omnipolar (Wang supplement). Clinical unipolar filter unknown [VERIFY]: unipoles get only the resampling filter.

peakFrequency._about: FM-10, FM-27. EnSite OT Near Field approximation: complex Morlet CWT (L1-normalised), PF trace = frequency of the largest magnitude per sample, samples below magnitudeGateFraction of the window maximum ignored. Two co-primary definitions: 'ensite' = highest remaining trace value (the published description); 'global' = frequency of the largest magnitude in the window (robust to noise-driven high-frequency trace values). PF undetectable when PP < 0.04 mV (Europace 2024). Wavelet, scales and gate are assumptions.

analysis._trailingContext: FM-36. Signal kept after the latest window for the wavelet transform only (the band-pass is causal). A Morlet wavelet (omega0 = 6) has time width omega0 / (2 pi f) = 31.8 ms at 30 Hz; four widths = 127 ms, rounded up. A numerical margin, not a clinical setting.

wangReference._about: Wang Table 2 median healthy-tissue bipolar voltage per region, and the limit of detection of her analysis (DETECTION_LIMIT in reference/EFOV_analysis_pipeline.Rmd: points at or below 0.01 mV are excluded). Reported beside the model's physical amplitudes only; never applied to the signals (FM-25). FM-44: detectionLimitMv / bipolarMedianMv is reported as a clinical reference for the relative noise floor, on the ASSUMPTION [VERIFY] that clinical noise peak-to-peak is of the order of that limit; no measured clinical noise is available (Junction 1).

export._about: Wang's DistAcrossPath = distance from the lesion-centre line; her BOUNDARY_OFFSET is 3 mm, so DistAcrossPath = distance inside the lesion - 3 mm. One dataset per gap, noise realisation and peak-frequency definition (FM-27).

groundTruth._maximumShareAbsSum: FM-43. A recording whose sum |s_e| exceeds this is flagged signedShareIllConditioned: its signal is nearly null, so its signed shares are large terms of opposite sign. Reporting convention (1 = no cancellation; 1.04-1.14 for unipoles and wave-aligned bipoles, above 9 for a bipole parallel to the wavefront, on a 10 x 16 mm test box; VL-2026-11-11-01). The |c|-mass is unaffected.
groundTruth._retained: FM-37. Share of an intact-run recording that comes from tissue with y >= boundaryYmm (the tissue still active after ablation), as a function of the recording's distance inside the lesion. groundTruth/boundaryCrossings.csv gives the distance where it first falls to each level. Levels are reporting conventions, like shapeLevels.
groundTruth._about: FM-15, FM-16, FM-21, FM-30. Shares s_e for every recording at these placements (classes, profiles, shape descriptors); full element fields (.vtk, npz) for fieldRecordings. nearFieldRadiusMm = one HD Grid electrode spacing: a stated convention, not a literature value; the continuous depth and lateral curves are the primary result. Lead fields and electrograms: openCARP's lead-field module, openCARP >= 20 (config/leadfield.par, efov/leadfield.py; FM-35).

tune._about: FM-18 (DL-2026-10-28-10 method): strip from the same mesher resolution, fibres along x, monodomain; beta <- beta (CV / target)^2.

physiology._about: Project engineering criteria (DL-2026-10-28-05), not validated biological limits. Measured on catheter-facing tissue nodes. The CV gate is in the tune stage (FM-18).

profile._about: Descriptive prerequisites for interpreting change points (project criteria).

tissue.source: FM-04 (mesh), FM-08 (wall); Roberts and Scher 1982 conductivities (DL-2026-11-02-03)

beta.source: FM-18; config/tuning.json records the mesh and CV target the model.par value was tuned for

pacing.source: 500 ms cycle length [VERIFY]; 4 beats and dt 20 us from the 1 Nov rule outcomes, fixed by FM-03

noise.source: 5 uV in model mV [VERIFY]; noise doubling series is the primary SNR test (FM-25)

lesion.source: FM-24: 5.6 mm ablation strip (Wang supplement, citing Friedman et al. 2021); isolated viable tissue beyond

amplitude.source: FM-25: physical model units, no calibration to Wang's voltages
